definition_en: flattering or coaxing words used to persuade someone
core_image: 有人捧着蜜罐在你耳边轻声劝诱
scene: 货郎把糖葫芦举到孩子面前，低声劝了半天。She refused to listen to his blandishments.
sceneCN: 这里 blandishment 是「甜言蜜语」（第 1 个义项：以奉承哄劝使人就范）；句意是她拒绝听信他的花言巧语。

pos.zh: 甜言蜜语；哄诱（常用复数）

derivatives.zh: 词根动词，义为「奉承；哄诱」
同根形容词，义为「温和的；讨好的」

senses.title: Flattering speech to persuade
senses.titleCN: 以奉承劝诱的甜言蜜语
senses.definition: words of praise and coaxing used to win someone over
senses.definitionCN: 以称赞与哄劝来赢得他人同意的话
senses.example: She refused to listen to his blandishments.
senses.exampleCN: 她拒绝听信他的花言巧语。
senses.why: Soft Latin blandus meant caressing in speech, and the noun names the caress of words.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 blandus 本指言辞的抚慰，名词所记的正是「言语的抚弄」。

senses.title: Coaxing meant to gain a favour
senses.definition: gentle urging aimed at obtaining a favour or concession
senses.definitionCN: 以温和劝诱谋取好处或让步
senses.example: After hours of blandishment, the manager granted the refund.
senses.exampleCN: 哄劝了几个小时后，经理同意了退款。
senses.why: The caress has an aim: softness is the tool, favour is the goal.
senses.whyCN: 抚弄自有目的：柔软是手段，好处是终点。

senses.title: The lure of fame or pleasure
senses.definition: the attractive pull of success, fame, or pleasure, treated as flattery
senses.definitionCN: 成功、名望或享乐如奉承般的吸引
senses.example: He could not resist the blandishments of the big city.
senses.exampleCN: 他抵挡不住大都市的种种诱惑。
senses.why: The city seems to whisper praise of what it offers, so its pull is a blandishment.
senses.whyCN: 城市仿佛在低声夸赞自己的馈赠，其吸引力因此成了甜言蜜语。

senses.title: Advertising and sales talk
senses.definition: persuasive commercial talk dressed as praise
senses.definitionCN: 包装成赞美之词的推销话术
senses.example: Ignore the blandishments of the sales brochure.
senses.exampleCN: 别理会宣传册里的花言巧语。
senses.why: Ads flatter the buyer while coaxing money out, the oldest use dressed new.
senses.whyCN: 广告一面奉承买主一面掏钱，是旧义披上新衣。

senses.title: Diplomatic or political coaxing
senses.definition: conciliatory language used in negotiation to soften resistance
senses.definitionCN: 谈判中用于软化对方抵制的安抚性言辞
senses.example: The envoy's blandishments eased the tense talks.
senses.exampleCN: 特使的安抚言辞缓和了紧张的谈判。
senses.why: Statecraft, like courtship, often prefers the soft touch to the threat.
senses.whyCN: 治国与求爱相通：常以软语代替威胁。

senses.title: Courtship talk
senses.definition: romantic coaxing addressed to a loved person
senses.definitionCN: 向心上人说的哄劝之语
senses.example: His letters were full of tender blandishment.
senses.exampleCN: 他的信里满是温柔缠绵的甜言蜜语。
senses.why: Love's persuasion is the home ground of the caressing word.
senses.whyCN: 求爱的劝诱正是「抚慰之语」的本源场域。

senses.title: Insincere praise from the ambitious
senses.definition: hollow flattery offered to a person of power for gain
senses.definitionCN: 为谋利而向权势者奉上的空洞赞美
senses.why: When praise is bought, the caress turns into currency.
senses.whyCN: 当赞美可以买卖，抚慰便变成了通货。

senses.title: Gentle enticement of things or comforts
senses.definition: the mild enticement of comfort, food, or ease
senses.definitionCN: 舒适、美食或安逸发出的温和引诱
senses.example: The warm fire made its own blandishment.
senses.exampleCN: 温暖的炉火自有一种温柔的引诱。
senses.why: Comfort, too, seems to coax; the word stretches from speech to feeling.
senses.whyCN: 安逸同样会「哄人」，该词由言语伸展到感受。

intro.en: Blandishment grows from Latin blandiri, to caress with words.
intro.cn: blandishment 源自拉丁语 blandiri「以言语抚慰」。

items.en: the deeper root is uncertain; possibly tied to gentle, slow motion.
items.cn: 更早词根来源不确定，一般认为与「轻缓的动作」相关。

items.en: blandiri meant to flatter, coax, fondle with words, from blandus, caressing.
items.cn: 拉丁语 blandiri 意为「奉承、哄诱」，出自 blandus「抚慰的」。

items.en: blandissement carried the flattering sense into French.
items.cn: 古法语 blandissement 承袭「奉承」之义。

items.en: English borrowed the word for coaxing and flattering speech.
items.cn: 英语于 16 世纪借入该词，指哄诱与奉承之语。

items.en: now usually plural, blandishments, for any seductive lure.
items.cn: 今多用复数 blandishments，泛指一切诱惑之辞。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the bland- root; the near-meaning group gathers words of flattery and lure.
note.cn: 形近组共享 bland- 词根；近义组汇集奉承与诱惑类词。

entries.definitionCN: 清淡的；温和的——同根形容词
惩罚——同含 -ment 后缀，词源不同
恳求——偏哀求而不含蜜语

normalIntro.en: Blandishment is the act of blandishing, coaxing with soft words.
normalIntro.cn: blandishment 即 blandish 的名词，指以软语哄劝。

normal.en: It usually appears in the plural.
normal.cn: 它通常以复数形式出现。

normal.en: The root bland means soft and flattering.
normal.cn: 词根 bland 意为「温柔的、讨好的」。

normal.en: It can describe the lure of a city or of fame.
normal.cn: 它可形容都市或名利的诱惑。

normal.en: Use resist or ignore with it.
normal.cn: 常与 resist 或 ignore 搭配。

normal.en: It is a formal, literary word.
normal.cn: 它是正式的书面语词汇。

abstract.en: Hear honey dripping from a stranger's mouth.
abstract.cn: 听陌生人嘴里滴下的蜜糖。

abstract.en: Feel a hand stroking your arm as it reaches for your purse.
abstract.cn: 感受那只抚着你手臂却伸向你钱包的手。

abstract.en: Picture a city neon sign whispering your name.
abstract.cn: 想象城市霓虹灯低声念着你的名字。

examples.en: She refused to listen to his blandishments.
examples.cn: 她拒绝听信他的花言巧语。

examples.en: He could not resist the blandishments of the big city.
examples.cn: 他抵挡不住大都市的种种诱惑。

examples.en: Ignore the blandishments of the sales brochure.
examples.cn: 别理会宣传册里的花言巧语。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「不来递上门」——甜言蜜语偏偏不请自来，还递上门来哄你。

root: 拉丁语 blandus「抚慰的、谄媚的」派生动词 blandiri「以言语哄诱」，其动名词经古法语 blandissement 进入英语（16 世纪），义为「甜言蜜语；哄诱」；bland- 词根更早来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: From courtly flattery to the lure of cities, blandishment names every soft word that pulls.
sensesIntro.cn: 从宫廷奉承到都市诱惑，blandishment 指一切具有拉力的软语。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: honey poured in the ear while a hand works the purse
core.cn: 核心意象：蜜糖灌进耳朵，另一只手伸向钱包

branches.en: Words that coax for a purpose
Lures of comfort, fame, and place
branches.cn: 安逸、名望与都市的诱惑

intro.cn: 该词呈现拉丁 -ment 后缀加于 bland- 词干之上。

latinIntro.en: Latin family of blandus and blandiri.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 blandus 与 blandiri 的词族。
